claims.verbatim:
Steamship Aleppo (Br.), McMicken, Liverpool, Aug. 14, via
Queenstown 15th, with mdse. and pass. to E. Cunard. Aug. 19, lat.
49 50, long. 35 03, passed British ship Ailsa, bound W; 21st, lat. 47 33,
long. 47 27, saw a large iceberg; 22d, lat. 45 20, long. 53 20, passed
British ship Huano, bound W.
